title: 12wk_WT_SCN_1
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated from DRG and SCN at 12 and 36 weeks of age from SD and HFD mice using a RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen, Germantown, MD). TapeStation (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA) was used to evaluate RNA quality and samples with an RNA integrity number of ≥8 were processed with the Illumina TruSeq mRNA Sample Prep v2 kit (Catalog #s RS122-2001, RS-122-2002; Illumina, San Diego, CA). | RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: Illumina Casava1.7 software used for basecalling. | Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then processed using the Tuxedo suite of sequence analysis programs. Reads were mapped to the NCBI reference mouse genome (mm10) to identify transcripts. | Trimmomatic software v0.36 (Bolger et al., 2014; PMID: 24695404) was used to remove the low-quality (Q<30) and sequencing adapters from raw reads. Clean reads were then mapped to the mouse reference genome (mm10) using HISAT2 (Kim et al., 2015; PMID: 25751142). The unique mapped reads to mouse genes were summarized with featureCounts (Liao et al., 2014; PMID: 24227677). | Assembly: NCBI38/mm10 | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include raw mapped counts for each Sample

TapeStation (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA) was used to evaluate RNA quality and samples with an RNA integrity number of ≥8 were processed with the Illumina TruSeq mRNA Sample Prep v2 kit (Catalog #s RS122-2001, RS-122-2002; Illumina, San Diego, CA). | RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: Illumina Casava1.7 software used for basecalling. | Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then processed using the Tuxedo suite of sequence analysis programs. Reads were mapped to the NCBI reference mouse genome (mm10) to identify transcripts. | Trimmomatic software v0.36 (Bolger et al., 2014; PMID: 24695404) was used to remove the low-quality (Q<30) and sequencing adapters from raw reads. Clean reads were then mapped to the mouse reference genome (mm10) using HISAT2 (Kim et al., 2015; PMID: 25751142). The unique mapped reads to mouse genes were summarized with featureCounts (Liao et al., 2014; PMID: 24227677). | Assembly: NCBI38/mm10 | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include raw mapped counts for each Sample
